proposals.current_pain_description: If a GHA workflow gets stuck in an infinite retry loop or generates large batches due to a code bug, it can consume Hugo's entire 20 EUR monthly budget on Runware in minutes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a stateful local file tracker (e.g., 'runware_budget.json') inside the repository. Before calling the Runware API, read the JSON. Track daily and monthly costs. If the daily limit (e.g., 2 EUR) or monthly limit (20 EUR) is exceeded, immediately fail the GHA step with a clear budget warning. Commit the updated budget file back to the repo at the end of every run.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents unexpected financial losses and account suspension on a strict bootstrap budget.

proposals.issue_title: Mobile-Friendly Asset Review Gallery via GitHub Pages
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates solely from an Android phone (Termux). Reviewing generated designs, books, and SVGs inside raw GitHub directories or downloading large ZIP files on mobile is slow, tedious, and discourages quality control.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a GHA post-processing step that generates a single, lightweight HTML file listing all newly generated images/PDF links with checkboxes. Deploy this automatically to a private or obfuscated GitHub Pages URL. Hugo can swipe through, select 'Approve', and tap a button to copy a list of approved filenames back to Termux to trigger the publication step.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 3-4 hours per week of manual mobile file navigation, turning QC into a 2-minute swipe-and-tap process.

proposals.issue_title: Silent API Image Generation Failures and Blank Assets
proposals.current_pain_description: APIs like Pollinations or free tier Together AI can fail silently, return HTTP 200 with blank/corrupted images, or return low-resolution placeholders. These are compiled directly into PDFs or ZIPs, leading to rejected KDP submissions or unusable products.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a Python Pillow validation step right after image download. Check that: 1) File size is > 5KB, 2) Image can be opened without PIL.UnidentifiedImageError, 3) Image variance of laplacian is > threshold (not a blank/solid color screen), and 4) Dimensions match requested size. Raise a clean exception and trigger a fallback API (e.g., Pollinations to Cloudflare) if validation fails.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates empty/corrupt files in final product batches, ensuring 100% of compiled PDF/ZIP pages are visually valid.

proposals.issue_title: Missing KDP Bleed and DPI Compliance Compiler
proposals.current_pain_description: Standard PDF generation scripts compile pages without exact bleed margins (0.125 inches extra on outer edges) or correct 300 DPI print-ready metadata. This causes Amazon KDP to reject the upload automatically, requiring tedious manual re-dimensioning.
proposals.proposed_fix: Standardize the PDF compilation script using ReportLab or PyPDF. Programmatically calculate strict page dimensions based on KDP formulas (e.g., for an 8.5x11 inch book with bleed: 8.625 x 11.25 inches). Force image DPI to 300 before embedding, and convert RGB images to print-safe margins with blank reverse pages for coloring books.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reaches 100% automatic approval rate on Amazon KDP upload without manual layout adjustments.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Actions IP Block Bypass via Cloudflare Worker Proxy
proposals.current_pain_description: GHA runners use shared Microsoft Azure/AWS IPs which are heavily blacklisted or rate-limited by AI Horde, Hugging Face, and other free AI providers, resulting in 403 Forbidden or 429 Too Many Requests.
proposals.proposed_fix: Deploy a free Cloudflare Worker (100k requests/day free tier) to act as a lightweight API reverse proxy. The GHA workflow sends requests to the Cloudflare Worker, which forwards them to the AI provider with custom headers, masking the GHA runner origin IP and performing automatic exponential backoff retries.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Bypasses IP-based blocking on free image generation APIs, stabilizing the core automated pipeline infrastructure.

proposals.issue_title: Cross-Pollination Asset Resizer (Single Output -> Multiple Formats)
proposals.current_pain_description: Designs are currently generated for one specific pipeline (e.g., a quote vector for a poster) and ignored for other formats, leaving high-quality assets unexploited on other platforms.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a shared post-generation script ('agent_cross_pollinator') that runs after any successful asset creation. It automatically copies the source high-res image and outputs: 1) A transparent PNG sticker format for Redbubble, 2) A high-res 4:5 ratio PDF for Etsy printables, and 3) A 1080x1920 vertical format for Pinterest/TikTok marketing.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Triples the surface area of every generated asset across Redbubble and Etsy with zero extra API generation costs.
